before.name: Karen Gargamelli-McCreight
before.description:
Karen Gargamelli-McCreight is an activist documented in Nuclear Resister’s reporting on protest arrests.

On 2025-04-17, Karen Gargamelli-McCreight was arrested at General Dynamics/Electric Boat, Connecticut. Arrested during the Holy Thursday nuclear-disarmament pilgrimage. Accepted community service at the May 1 arraignment, according to the May 15 report. The source does not give an actual jail interval.
